prayerExcerpt.en-US: Let us bear in mind that the ills of this life are not worthy to be compared to the glory "God has reserved for those who love Him."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tenhamos em mente que os males desta vida não são dignos de ser comparados com a glória que "Deus reservou para aqueles que O amam".

meta.face: A Roman patrician of about thirty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, fair-skinned with a light flush, with a LONG, RECTANGULAR face and a STRONG, FLAT-BOTTOMED jaw as wide as the cheekbones — a high, broad forehead, a Roman nose with a HIGH bridge and a slight HOOK, DEEP-SET, grey-green eyes under straight, fair-brown brows, flat cheeks, a WIDE, thin-lipped mouth, a long neck; short, TIGHT, close-cropped fair curls; the gaze eager and bright. Not the smooth-oval, fringe-haired alexander, the round-faced boy pancras, the angular, cleft-chinned victor_marseilles, the long-headed romanus_ostiarius, or the heart-shaped youngest of forty_martyrs_sebaste.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. Pontormo's painting (Wikipedia's lead image) makes him a young man; the card keeps his youth and senatorial rank from the book and the Martyrology ('senatore'), and puts him at Amiens, where the book has him preach and suffer.
